Topic 1.3.1: Painting MAKING TECHNIQUES

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Painting MAKING TECHNIQUES. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What do you use MAKING leaner should be able to: • Guide learners to use one colour for painting?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. perform free choice using brushes painting on paper for • Display own painted work enjoyment • Guide learner to share comments
2. appreciate own and others painted work

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. perform free choice using brushes painting on paper for • Display own painted work enjoyment • Guide learner to share comments

Example 1: Talk about Painting MAKING TECHNIQUES using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.
